audit_commit.subject: B5: add experiment entry script + ignore run artifacts

implementation_commit.subject: B5: early-stop, anomaly pause, strict safe-recovery (K1-K6 + decisions A/B + P1-P8)

supplemental_record_commit.subject: docs: R2.16 supplemental B5 decision record

b5_parameters.pause_state_schema: 9-field P5 final form (6 required + 3 optional); no 10th field

smoke.output_dir_sha_status: run artifacts are .gitignore-excluded and not committed; directory kept locally only
smoke.notes: val_loss stayed below the warning threshold throughout; step 1 and step 10 fell inside the exemption window, so the observed val_loss=1.2400 at step 1 was NOT counted. No anomaly, no hard-stop, no pause_state.json written.

main.warning_event: P2 record-only warning triggered at step 100 (val_loss=1.2343 >= warning threshold 1.23400, 2 consecutive qualifying evals at steps 90 and 100); training completed normally, no stop
main.notes: No hard-stop triggered (val_loss never reached 1.24014). No pause_state.json written. All checkpoints were written on the normal (non-stopped) eval steps, consistent with Decision B.

tests.b5_specific_coverage_note: Includes fault-injection tests for: hard-stop trigger + state-write + no-checkpoint, anomaly pause halt + counter preservation + state-write, state-write failure (unwritable parent dir), hard-stop non-resumability, strict resume rejection on step/config/vocab/seq_len mismatch, 9-field P5 schema verification, P8 no-auto-recovery, and legacy log-key stability on anomaly. All runs use tmp_path fixtures and mocked evaluate(); no real checkpoint or training directory is touched.

behavior_verified_by_real_training: exemption window (steps 1-10 inclusive) does not increment counters
clear-below-threshold semantics for the warning counter
P2 warning recorded but not stopping when hard-stop threshold not met
checkpoints written on the normal (non-stopped) eval path
no pause_state.json written when no anomaly or hard-stop occurred
behavior_verified_by_tests_only: hard-stop termination + 9-field state JSON write + no checkpoint on stop
anomaly (nan/inf/failed/empty) pause halts the loop, counters preserved, state JSON written
state-write failure stops training without checkpoint or fallback
hard_stop state can never be resumed via resume_from_pause
strict resume rejection on step mismatch, config checksum mismatch, vocab_size mismatch, max_seq_len mismatch
P8: mere existence of a valid state file does NOT auto-trigger recovery
P5: written state files contain exactly the approved 9 fields and no 10th field
legacy (B5 off) log-entry shape stability when the validator returns a non-ok status
explicit_acceptance_limitations: Normal training completion does NOT validate hard-stop or anomaly-pause under real fault conditions. Those paths are exercised only by isolated fault-injection tests using mocked evaluators; no real run of the B5 experiment triggered a hard-stop or anomaly.
CPU and memory peak usage were not sampled during either run (no psutil or equivalent instrumentation was in scope); the fields above are recorded as null, not estimated.
experiments/b5/* run artifacts (checkpoints, logs, metadata, pause-state JSONs) are excluded from Git via .gitignore; only the entry script and this summary JSON are committed.
open_issues: Real-fault-trigger acceptance of hard-stop / anomaly-pause / state-write-failure / strict-resume is pending a controlled fault-injection experiment (e.g. temporarily lowering hard_stop_threshold or injecting a NaN eval value in an isolated output directory, never touching the two completed runs above).
Resource peak sampling (CPU / memory) would require a lightweight psutil-style hook in run_b5.py; no such instrumentation was added in this pass to keep the change set minimal.
The --b5-off comparison run has not been executed; legacy behavior is guaranteed instead by the 50 regression tests.
